final_message:
All tests pass, including edge cases (negative sub-dollar amounts, tie-breaking, comment/blank-line skipping, default `n`).

Bugs fixed:
1. **`parse_date`** (ledger/parse.py:9) — returned `(year, day, month)`; swapped month/day to match the documented `(year, month, day)`.
2. **`format_cents`** (ledger/money.py:20) — floor division/modulo on negative cents produced `-$-4.90` for `-310`; now takes `abs()` before splitting dollars/cents so negatives render as `-$3.10`.
3. **`top_items`** (ledger/report.py:23) — sorted totals ascending with no tie-break; now sorts by `(-total, item)` for descending totals with ties broken by item name ascending.
